title: Moneyball for College Sports
summary: Dropback helps teams play Moneyball: the arbitrage between the market value and your value. Our advanced software takes into account your budget, your schemes, and your priorities to deliver a defensible data-driven valuation process for your athletes.
body_markdown:
Ah, Moneyball... the #1 buzzword in college sports right now.


*But... What does that actually mean? *


Dropback defines Moneyball as the arbitrage between the market value and your value.


Over the past year of building Dropback, this remains our #1 insight from NFL/NBA/MLB Front Offices: take into account your budget, your schemes, and your priorities to deliver a defensible data-driven valuation process for your athletes.


Sounds cool... but how does this work? Check out our latest 10-minute product deep dive here 👇


*Link not working? *[https://x.com/lukebogus/status/1925998140219412914](https://x.com/lukebogus/status/1925998140219412914)


### Don't have 10 minutes? I'll spare you the highlights:


- Build models for every position, to articulate the metrics/targets/baselines that matter to *you* . The output? A valuation rooted in *your* strategy & *your* budget--made by *you* .


- Apply these custom models to your roster, or to 50,000+ athletes automatically with our 'Search' feature
